text:
```yaml
name: Check PR Title

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      - opened
      - edited
      - synchronize

permissions:
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  main:
    name: Validate PR Title
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: amannn/action-semantic-pull-request@v5
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          # Configure which types are allowed (newline-separated)
          types: |
            feat
            fix
            chore
            docs
            style
            refactor
            perf
            test
            build
            ci
            revert
          # Configure which scopes are allowed (newline-separated)
          # Optional scopes are allowed by default if not specified
          # subjectPattern: ^(?![A-Z]).+$
          # subjectPatternError: |
          #   The subject "{subject}" found in the pull request title "{title}"
          #   should start with a lowercase character.
```
